This state of desolation... is here called the cup of the anger and wrath of Jehovah, and the cup of trembling (). AE 406:12.
The reason the laver was according to the work of the laver of a cup (), was that by a cup, a cup, or a cup, is signified the Scientific which is of man's Natural or Sensual.
With the cup of devastation and desolation () = the falsities of evil which utterly devastate and desolate all the goods and truths of the Church.
